subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this broad report remain an umbrella, or should maintainers split it into canonical fixes for sessions_send channel derivation, TUI default-session behavior, WeChat plugin identity routing, and activity/background-event isolation?
rationale: The source-level gaps are real, but the item spans core Gateway RPCs, TUI defaults, external WeChat plugin routing, cron/subagent event isolation, and session activity taxonomy; automation should not choose those boundaries without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split And Route Sub-Bugs
options.body: Keep this issue open as context, file or link focused canonical items for each behavior, then close the umbrella only after the unique evidence is preserved.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the coordinating tracker, but require maintainer-owned review before any broad implementation PR is accepted.

options.title: Close After Canonicals Are Confirmed
options.body: If maintainers decide the narrower issues fully cover every remaining behavior, close this issue only after linking those canonical items and preserving the WeChat/CLI evidence.

recommendation.title: Split And Route Sub-Bugs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as context, file or link focused canonical items for each behavior, then close the umbrella only after the unique evidence is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history in Sessions UI/product work and sessions_send stabilization, so he is the best available owner for the split-versus-umbrella decision.
